card: Removes the unused GetVirtualTransactionInputSize function from policy code and updates the remaining fuzz and wallet tests. The helper became dead code after wallet input size estimation moved to descriptors in PR #26567. This is a routine internal cleanup with no user-facing or consensus impact.
changed_since_previous: No functional changes; diff provided matches the previous description.
evidence: Commit message: "The last non-test caller was removed in 9b7ec393b8 (#26567), when the wallet switched to estimating input sizes using descriptors. Since then it has only been used by the tx_in fuzz target and a helper in wallet_tests."
problem: `GetVirtualTransactionInputSize` has had no non-test callers since wallet input size estimation was changed to use descriptors in PR #26567, leaving dead code in the policy module.

risk.why: It deletes an unused helper function and inline declarations with no remaining production callers.

summary: Removes the unused `GetVirtualTransactionInputSize` helper function from the policy module. It also drops its invocation from the `tx_in` fuzz target and replaces it with direct weight calculation in a wallet unit test.
